required_invariants: LOCAL METRIC WIN != END-TO-END OUTCOME WIN
ADAPTER FREEDOM != AUTHORITY TO MUTATE CORE SEMANTICS
Existing Human Gates cannot be weakened

tests.workload: Render one evidence-bound core claim into materially different channel/UI adapters.
tests.win_condition: Adapters may change form, length and emphasis while protected semantic claims remain equivalent and provenance stays bound.
tests.reject_if: It freezes presentation style as semantics or permits a derived adapter to mutate the protected claim.

tests.workload: A user states an observable want while an analyst/model infers a deeper latent need.
tests.win_condition: Raw observation, interpretation and validated fact remain typed separately; inference can guide a probe but cannot masquerade as first-party evidence.
tests.reject_if: Repeated or persuasive inference is allowed to become observed fact without independent validation.

tests.workload: An upstream stage metric improves while the frozen downstream protected outcome degrades.
tests.win_condition: Local optimization cannot promote a change that materially worsens the protected end-to-end outcome, unless the downstream relation is explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE.
tests.reject_if: It creates a mandatory downstream business/product dependency for workloads that have no such downstream surface.

tests.workload: Aggregate metrics hide opposite outcomes across material cohorts/contexts.
tests.win_condition: A material evidence-bound context can block a global diagnosis and force targeted analysis without encouraging arbitrary post-hoc segmentation.
tests.reject_if: Any tiny or invented segment can veto the aggregate, or segmentation is used without predeclared/materiality evidence.

promotion_rule: No challenger becomes canonical from contract tests. Same-workload evidence and existing promotion authority remain mandatory.
